BLPA: Those who have tasted the true essence of the True Lord, remain satisfied and fulfilled.
They, who enjoy the True Lord's true elixir, remain sated and satiated.
WUNP: They know this essence of the Lord, but they say nothing, like the mute who tastes the sweet candy, and says nothing.
Like the dumb person's eating sweets they can only realise the deliciousness of this Nectar of God.
Y47Y: The Perfect Guru serves the Lord God; His vibration vibrates and resounds in the mind. ||18||
The Perfect Guru performs the service of the Lord God and people congratulate him.
2WED: Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.
They who have carbuncle within knows its pain.
28XS: Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.
I am ever a sacrifice to those who realise the pang of separation from God.
NT7C: O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shall roll in the dust under His feet.
O Omnipotent God unite me with the Guru the friend. My head is a sacrifice to him and shall roll under his feet.
UYJF: I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.
I am a slave of the slaves of those disciples of the Guru who perform his service.
VS1N: Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robes are drenched in the Love of the Lord.
Drenched in God's love are the raiment of those who are imbued with the fast red dye of the Lord.
BSLD: Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him. ||1||
My master mercifully cause Nanak to meet the Guru to whom he has sold his head for consideration.
YXKU: The body is full of mistakes and misdeeds; how can it become pure, O Saints?
The body is full of sins. How can this become pure, O saints?
BDUN: The Gurmukh purchases virtues, which wash off the sin of egotism.
Through the Guru the virtues are purchased which wash off the filth of pride.
9DA7: True is the trade which purchases the True Lord with love.
True is the trade of buying the True Load with love.
0VC1: No loss will come from this, and the profit comes by the Lord's Will.
Like this man never suffers a loss and earns profit as is the will of that Lord.
HXNB: O Nanak, they alone purchase the Truth, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
Nanak they alone purchase the True Name who are gifted with such a pre-ordained writ.
PKFB: I praise the True One, who alone is worthy of praise. The True Primal Being is True - this is His unique quality.
I praise the True One who is worthy of praise. Truly the True Lord is unique.
7FP5: Serving the True Lord, the Truth comes to dwell in the mind. The Lord, the Truest of the True, is my Protector.
By serving the True Being truth abides in the mind. God, the Truest of the true is my preserver.
6F9C: Those who worship and adore the Truest of the True, shall go and merge with the True Lord.
They who remember the Truest of the true go and blend with the True Lord.
UKXM: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish demons.
They who serve not the Truest of the true are foolish and self-conceited devils.
N8HU: With their mouths, they babble on about this and that, like the drunkard who has drunk his wine. ||19||
With their mouth they talk high and low. like the drunkard who has quaffed wine.
R9UC: Gauree Raga is auspicious, if, through it, one comes to think of his Lord and Master.
Gauri Rag is auspicious if in it man remembers His Master.
0VBC: He should walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; this should be his decoration.
He should walk in the will of the True Guru, such decoration he ought to make.
7LZ9: The True Word of the Shabad is our spouse; ravish and enjoy it, forever and ever.
The True Word is mortal's spouse Ever and ever, he should enjoy it.
TN11: Like the deep crimson color of the madder plant - such is the dye which shall color you, when you dedicate your soul to the True One.
As is the deep red dye of boiled madder such a dye you shall have by devoting your soul to the True Lord.
DDG3: One who loves the True Lord is totally imbued with the Lord's Love, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.
She who bears love to the True One is thoroughly dyed like the dye of the tulip.
WBR3: Falsehood and deception may be covered with false coatings, but they cannot remain hidden.
Falsehood and deception wrapped up in false gilding remain not undetected.
AMVC: False is the uttering of praises, by those who love falsehood.
False is the uttering of praises of those who love falsehood.
PWKQ: O Nanak, He alone is True; He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||
Nanak God alone is True and He Himself casts His favourable glance.
X2QK: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Lord's Praises are sung. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Beloved Lord is met.
In the saints guild God's praise is sung. By associating with the saints the Beloved is met.
Q6WE: Blessed is that mortal being, who shares the Teachings for the good of others.
Among men blest is that mortal being who imparts instruction for the good of others.
K6WH: He implants the Name of the Lord, and he preaches the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, the world is saved.
God's Name he enjoins and God's Name he preaches. Through God's Name the world is emancipated.
BPDG: Everyone longs to see the Guru; the world, and the nine continents, bow down to Him.
all long to see the Guru. The world of nine continents bows before him.
TEYR: You Yourself have established the True Guru; You Yourself have adorned the Guru.
Yours ownself You have places in the True Guru and You Yourself has bedecked the Guru, O Lord.
ZL2Z: You Yourself worship and adore the True Guru; You inspire others to worship Him as well, O Creator Lord.
My Creator You Yourself adorest the True Guru and causest others to adore him.
49ER: If someone separates himself from the True Guru, his face is blackened, and he is destroyed by the Messenger of Death.
If some one separates himself from the True Guru his face goes black and him the death's courier destroys.

CAY8: He shall find no shelter, here or hereafter; the GurSikhs have realized this in their minds.
The Guru's disciples have realised in their mind that here and hereafter he shall find no shelter.
WMVE: That humble being who meets the True Guru is saved; he cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart.
The man who meets the True Guru and who in his mind remembers the Name is saved.
2E5J: Servant Nanak says: O GurSikhs, O my sons, meditate on the Lord; only the Lord shall save you. ||2||
O you, Sikhs and sons of the Guru meditate on the Lord God and He shall deliver you says slave Nanak.
6200: Egotism has led the world astray, along with evil-mindedness and the poison of corruption.
Egotism mal-intellect and the poison of sin have led astray the world.
X0WR: Meeting with the True Guru, we are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, while the self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.
If an apostate who is in total darkness meets the True Guru then he comes to possess vision.
C3AT: O Nanak, the Lord absorbs into Himself those whom He inspires to love the Word of His Shabad. ||3||
Nanak the Lord blends with Himself the mortal whom He causes to love His Name.
LQVU: True are the Praises and the Glories of the True One; he alone speaks them, whose mind is softened within.
True is the glory and praise of the True One. He alone undertakes it whose mind is softened
3AAS: Those who worship the One Lord with single-minded devotion - their bodies shall never perish.
They, who meditate on the Unique One with single mind their body never perishes.
WGA9: Blessed, blessed and acclaimed is that person, who tastes with his tongue the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.
Blessed blessed and praiseworthy is the person who with his tongue tastes the True Name Nectar.
956Y: One whose mind is pleased with the Truest of the True is accepted in the True Court.
The man to whose mind the Truest of the true is pleasing becomes acceptable in the True court.
FYNR: Blessed, blessed is the birth of those true beings; the True Lord brightens their faces. ||20||
Hail hail to the birth of the true persons, whose faces the True Lord renders bright.
GT5Z: The faithless cynics go and bow before the Guru, but their minds are corrupt and false, totally false.
The mammon-worshippers go and bow to the Guru but their mind is base and filled with utter falsehood.
S5UM: When the Guru says, "Rise up, my Siblings of Destiny", they sit down, crowded in like cranes.
When the Guru says "Rise and work, My brethren", they get crammed in some how and sit like cranes.
488V: The True Guru prevails among His GurSikhs; they pick out and expel the wanderers.
The True Guru abides among his Sikhs. They pick up and expel the wanderers.
XDWS: Sitting here and there, they hide their faces; being counterfeit, they cannot mix with the genuine.
Sitting here and there they conceal their face and being counterfeit they mix not with the genuine.
14DU: There is no food for them there; the false go into the filth like sheep.
There is no food for them there. The false go and find filth like sheep.
QCY9: If you try to feed the faithless cynic, he will spit out poison from his mouth.
If we desire to feed and apostate person he will spew and throw out poison from his mouth.
FQAZ: O Lord, let me not be in the company of the faithless cynic, who is cursed by the Creator Lord.
O God give me not the company of the mammon worshipper. He is accursed of the Creator.
S9U0: This drama belongs to the Lord; He performs it, and He watches over it. Servant Nanak cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
He to whom this play belongs does and beholds it. Servant Nanak remembers Lord's Name.
0P9F: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is inaccessible; He has enshrined the Lord's Name within His heart.
Unfathomable is the person of the True Guru, who has treasured up God within his heart.
YHVQ: No one can equal the True Guru; the Creator Lord is on His side.
None can equal the True Guru on whose side the Creator Himself is.
WW42: Devotional worship of the Lord is the sword and armor of the True Guru; He has killed and cast out Death, the torturer.
God's meditation is the sword and armour of the True Guru with which he has destroyed and cast off death the torturer.
GHWQ: The Lord Himself is the Protector of the True Guru. The Lord saves all those who follow in the footsteps of the True Guru.
God Himself is the protector of the True Guru. The Lord saves all who follow in the foot-steps of the True Guru.
4CYL: One who thinks evil of the Perfect True Guru - the Creator Lord Himself destroys him.
The maker Himself smites him who thinks evil of the perfect True Guru.
Q93G: These words will be confirmed as true in the Court of the Lord; servant Nanak reveals this mystery. ||2||
This word is of the court of the True God. Servant Nanak utters this prophecy.
FTCF: Those who dwell upon the True Lord while asleep, utter the True Name when they are awake.
They who remember the True Lord while asleep utter the True Name when awake.
3SB6: How rare in the world are those Gurmukhs who dwell upon the True Lord.
Rare are known to be such beings in the world who contemplate over the True Lord, through the Guru.
EWZ4: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the True Name, night and day.
I am devoted to those who night and day repeat the True Name.
WFML: The True Lord is pleasing to their minds and bodies; they go to the Court of the True Lord.
They to whose mind and body the True Lord is pleasing arrive at the True court.
XXKW: Servant Nanak chants the True Name; truly, the True Lord is forever brand new. ||21||
Slave Nanak, utters the True Name. Truly the True Lord is ever brand new.
ZZ4Z: Who is asleep, and who is awake? Those who are Gurmukh are approved.
What is sleeping and what is waking? Those turned Guru-wards they are approved.

H97G: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each and every breath and morsel of food, are the perfect and famous persons.
They who with every breath and morsel forget not the Lord are the perfect and distinguished persons.
A1ZV: By His Grace they find the True Guru; night and day, they meditate.
By God's grace they obtain the True Guru and night and day fix their attention on God.
P0AJ: I join the society of those persons, and in so doing, I am honored in the Court of the Lord.
I continue to mix with the society of those persons and I obtain honour in God's court.
1TWG: While asleep, they chant, "Waaho! Waaho!", and while awake, they chant, "Waaho!" as well.
While asleep they utter Lord's glories and praises and when awake they eulogise Him as well.
5CRK: O Nanak, radiant are the faces of those, who rise up early each day, and dwell upon the Lord. ||1||
Nanak bright are the faces of those who daily arise early and remember God.
UMG7: Serving his True Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.
By serving his True Guru man obtains the Name of the Infinite Lord.
AEWE: The drowning person is lifted up and out of the terrifying world-ocean; the Great Giver gives the gift of the Lord's Name.
Guru the giver, gives the gift of God's Name and pulls out the drowning man from the dreadful world-ocean.
0FXS: Blessed, blessed are those bankers who trade the Naam.
Blest blest are the bankers who deal in the trade of God's Name.
9DJ0: The Sikhs, the traders come, and through the Word of His Shabad, they are carried across.
The Sikh pedlars come and with God's Name the Guru ferries them across.
9KHG: O servant Nanak, they alone serve the Creator Lord, who are blessed by His Grace. ||2||
They alone serve the Creator, O Slave Nanak on whom is God's grace.
T5PM: Those who truly worship and adore the True Lord, are truly the humble devotees of the True Lord.
They who meditate on the Truest of the true are truly the devoted slaves of the True Lord.
CAM0: Those Gurmukhs who search and seek, find the True One within themselves.
The Guru-wards who make a thorough search they find the True One within themselves.
ZR67: Those who truly serve their True Lord and Master, overwhelm and conquer Death, the torturer.
They who heartily serve the True Master overwhelm and vanquish the thorny death.
68LF: The True One is truly the greatest of all; those who serve the True One are blended with the True One.
Truly, the True One is the highest of all. They who serve the True One blend with the True One.
9XSA: Blessed and acclaimed is the Truest of the True; serving the Truest of the True, one blossoms forth in fruition. ||22||
Blessed is the Truest of the true One blooms by serving the Truest of the true.
M7UP: The self-willed manmukh is foolish; he wanders around without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Foolish is the perverse person without the Lord's Name he wanders about.
ZMVX: Without the Guru, his mind is not held steady, and he is reincarnated, over and over again.
Without the Guru his mind becomes not steady and he enters womb again and again.
49K2: But when the Lord God Himself becomes merciful to him, then the True Guru comes to meet him.
When the Lord God Himself becomes merciful then alone the Guru comes and meets the man.
5UB3: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam; the pains of birth and death shall come to an end. ||1||
Praise you God's Name, O slave Nanak that your pain of birth and death may end.
QGX9: I praise my Guru in so many ways, with joyful love and affection.
With superb love, I praise my Guru in many a way.
7XVQ: My mind is imbued with the True Guru; He has preserved the make of its making.
With the True Guru my mind is imbued. The Guru has beautifully preserved it.
XBS4: My tongue is not satisfied by praising Him; He has linked my consciousness with the Lord, my Beloved.
My tongue is not sated by praising the Guru who has attached my mind with God the Beloved.
6BN6: O Nanak, my mind hungers for the Name of the Lord; my mind is satisfied, tasting the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak mind has the hunger for the Name and mind is satiated by tasting God's elixir.
Y448: The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned the days and the nights.
Truly, the True Lord who has made days and nights is known through His Omnipotence.
SWMP: I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.
Ever, ever I praise that True one, True are the praises of the True one.
JDZX: True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannot be appraised.
True is the praiseworthy Lord and true is His praise. None has ever appraised the True Lord's worth.
95Y9: When someone meets the Perfect True Guru, then His Sublime Presence comes to be seen.
When the perfect True Guru is met then manifest are seen His glories.
XYCL: Those Gurmukhs who praise the True Lord - all their hunger is gone. ||23||
The Guru-wards who sing the praise of the True Lord all their hungers are stilled. (over).
NYD5: Searching and examining my mind and body, I have found that God, whom I longed for.
Thoroughly searching my mind and body I have found that Lord whom I wanted.
9K07: I have found the Guru, the Divine Intermediary, who has united me with the Lord God. ||1||
I have attained to Guru the mediator who has united me with the Lord God.
B79J: One who is attached to Maya is totally blind and deaf.
The man attached to mammon is very blind and deaf.
ESZC: He does not listen to the Word of the Shabad; he makes a great uproar and tumult.
He hears not the Name and makes a great uproar and tumult.
N32Z: The Gurmukhs chant and meditate on the Shabad, and lovingly center their consciousness on it.
The pious persons are known by enshrining live for Lord's Name.
TBN7: They hear and believe in the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.
They hear and believe in God's Name and in God's Name they are absorbed.
28YU: Whatever pleases God, He causes that to be done.
Whatever pleases Him that He does and causes to be done.
SNRA: O Nanak, human beings are the instruments which vibrate as God plays them. ||2||
Nanak human being the instrument plays as the Lord causes him to play.

95ET: You, O Creator, know everything which occurs within our beings.
You O creator knowest every thing which is taking place within the mortals minds.
QPAZ: You Yourself, O Creator, are incalculable, while the entire world is within the realm of calculation.
You yourself are Incomputable Maker. The entire world is within calculation.
ENVU: Everything happens according to Your Will; You created all.
Everything comes to pass as You directest all are created by You.
M6LP: You are the One, pervading in each and every heart; O True Lord and Master, this is Your play.
O True Lord, You alone are contained in every heart. This play is all Yours.
5Z0Q: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24||
He who meets the True Guru meets God and none can turn him back.
HTLP: Hold this mind steady and stable; become Gurmukh and focus your consciousness.
Let this mind be kept steady and attention on the Lord be focused through the Guru.
8TPZ: How could you ever forget Him, with each breath and morsel of food, sitting down or standing up?
Why should we ever forget Him sitting and standing and with every breath and morsel of ours?
LL0J: My anxiety about birth and death has ended; this soul is under the control of the Lord God.
Now that I have given over this soul under the control of Lord God my anxiety of death and birth has ceased.
CBJL: If it pleases You, then save servant Nanak, and bless him with Your Name. ||1||
As it pleases You, so do You save slave Nanak and grant Yours Name.
PT5J: The egotistical, self-willed manmukh does not know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; one moment he is here, and the next moment he is there.
The proud apostate knows not Guru's court. He remains a little hither of a little thither.
RQ98: He is always invited, but he does not go to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. How shall he be accepted in the Court of the Lord?
Though ever invited he goes not to Guru's court. How shall he be accepted in God's court?
P8HD: How rare are those who know the Mansion of the True Guru; they stand with their palms pressed together.
Some rare one knows Guru's court and who knows it ever stands with clasped hands.
A0Y4: If my Lord grants His Grace, O Nanak, He restores them to Himself. ||2||
Nanak if my God shows mercy he restores man to Guru's court.
AA04: Fruitful and rewarding is that service, which is pleasing to the Guru's Mind.
Profitable is the performance of that service with which the True Guru's mind is pleased.
25W5: When the Mind of the True Guru is pleased, then sins and misdeeds run away.
When the mind of the True Guru is propitiated then the sins and evil-deeds flee.
RW3W: The Sikhs listen to the Teachings imparted by the True Guru.
with their ears, the Sikhs hear the instruction which the True Guru imparts.
VSQW: Those who surrender to the True Guru's Will are imbued with the four-fold Love of the Lord.
They who submit to the True Guru's will are imbued with fourfold dye (of love).
GSQ7: This is the unique and distinct life-style of the Gurmukhs: listening to the Guru's Teachings, their minds blossom forth. ||25||
This is the peculiar way of life of the Guru's Sikhs, that their soul flowers by hearing Guru's teaching.
DAME: Those who do not affirm their Guru shall have no home or place of rest.
He who disowns his Guru has no place or abode.
LVDM: They lose both this world and the next; they have no place in the Court of the Lord.
This world and the world hereafter he loses, both and finds not room in God's court.
NH0Q: This opportunity to bow at the Feet of the True Guru shall never come again.
This chance of falling at the True Guru's feet cannot be attained to again.
LUUM: If they miss out on being counted by the True Guru, they shall pass their lives in pain and misery.
Were man to miss being counted among the disciples of the True Guru he shall pass his life in deep distress.
0SL3: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.
The Omnipotent Satguru is without enmity, with himself he attaches any, whom he likes.
XZPN: O Nanak, those who behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, are emancipated in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
Nanak at a God's court, the Guru secures the release of those whom he has caused to see Lord's sight.
7S2M: The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.
The self-willed person is spiritually blind, evil-minded and arrogant.
QYX0: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.
Within him is wrath and he loses his sense as if in a gamble.
TUHG: He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.
He commits the sins of falsehood and unrighteousness.
D4KH: What can he hear, and what can he tell others?
What can he hear and what can he tell others?
QPDD: He is blind and deaf; he loses his way, and wanders lost in the wilderness.
He is blind and deaf and losing his way he strays into wilderness.
8HNP: The blind, self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation;
The blind apostate continues coming and going.
EZ7P: without meeting the True Guru, he finds no place of rest.
Without meeting the True Guru he finds no place of rest.
0YZF: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
Nanak he acts according to pre ordained writ.
5MDG: Those who have hearts as hard as stone, do not sit near the True Guru.
They whose hearts are hard sit not near the True Guru.
1DNH: Truth prevails there; the false ones do not attune their consciousness to it.
Truth prevails there and the liars feel mentally depressed.
UBAV: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.
By hook and crook they pass their time and again go and sit with the false ones.
D4JC: Falsehood does not mix with the Truth; O people, check it out and see.
In truth falsehood mixes not O my soul see this through verification.
6WAH: The false go and mingle with the false, while the truthful Sikhs sit by the side of the True Guru. ||26||
The false ones go and mix with the false ones. The true Sikhs sit by the side of the True Guru.

GWW5: By their own efforts, the slanderers have destroyed all remnants of themselves.
By making effort, the Lord has Himself destroyed the remnants of slanderers.
4LQV: The Support of the Saints, O Nanak, is manifest, pervading everywhere. ||1||
O Nanak Lord the succour of saints is manifestly pervading every-where.
321P: Those who went astray from the Primal Being in the very beginning - where can they find refuge?
They who go astray from the Primal being from the very beginning where can they find refuge?
UV1C: O Nanak, they are struck down by the All-powerful, the Cause of causes. ||2||
Nanak they are smitten by Him, who is Omnipotent to do all works.
2JD8: They take the noose in their hands, and go out at night to strangle others, but God knows everything, O mortal.
Taking halters men go out at night to strangle others but the Lord knows all O mortal.
S95J: They spy on other men's women, concealed in their hiding places.
Concealed in places they look at other women.
2JEL: They break into well-protected places, and revel in sweet wine.
They break into places, difficult of access, and enjoy wine deeming it sweet.
2AAS: But they shall come to regret their actions - they create their own karma.
Over their respective misdeeds they shall themselves misdeeds, they shall themselves afterwards regret.
1AHV: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall crush them like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||27||
Azrail the courier of death, shall crush them like the mill full of sesame.
AEZZ: The servants of the True King are acceptable and approved.
They who are the servants of the True king become acceptable.
H25L: Those ignorant ones who serve duality, O Nanak, rot, waste away and die. ||1||
Nanak the ignorant who serve others they rot putrefy and die.
NTRR: That destiny which was pre-ordained by God from the very beginning cannot be erased.
The destiny which the Lord wrote in the beginning cannot be erased.
LLZM: The wealth of the Lord's Name is Nanak's capital; he meditates on it forever. ||2||
The wealth of Pervading God's Name is Nanak's capital and he ever meditates on it.
AJ9A: One who has received a kick from the Lord God - where can he place his foot?
Where can he place his foot, who has received a kick, from the Lord?
60UA: He commits countless sins, and continually eats poison.
He commits numberless sins and ever, eats poison.
PL1M: Slandering others, he wastes away and dies; within his body, he burns.
Slandering others he pines away to death.
T05B: One who has been struck down by the True Lord and Master - who can save him now?
Within his body he continues burning. Who can save him, whom the True Lord has smitten?
BQ4R: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Unseen Lord, the Primal Being. ||28||
Nanak has entered His asylum who is the Unseen Lord.
8HZK: In the most horrible hell, there is terrible pain and suffering. It is the place of the ungrateful.
In the terrible hell there is very much suffering. It is an abode of the ungrateful.
3NWR: They are struck down by God, O Nanak, and they die a most miserable death. ||1||
They are smitten by that Lord and they die a miserable death, O Nanak.
DRLB: All kinds of medicines may be prepared, but there is no cure for the slanderer.
Many sorts of medicines are prepared but there is no cure for the slanderer.
LGS9: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads, O Nanak, putrefy and rot in reincarnation. ||2||
They whom the Lord himself misleads rot and putrefy in existences, O Nanak.
0CHS: By His Pleasure, the True Guru has blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of the Name of the True Lord.
The perfect Satguru has in his mercy blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of the Name of True God.
2VK7: All my anxiety is ended; I am rid of the fear of death.
All my anxieties have ceased and I am rid of the fear of death.
D619: Sexual desire, anger and other evils have been subdued in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The lust, wrath and other evils are stilled in the saints guild.
6BEX: Those who serve another, instead of the True Lord, die unfulfilled in the end.
Sans the True Lord those who serve another, die like a larva.
TRTN: The Guru has blessed Nanak with forgiveness; he is united with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||29||
The Guru has pardoned Nanak and he is united with God's Name.
TPP8: He is not a penitent, who is greedy within his heart, and who constantly chases after Maya like a leper.
He is not a penitent, whose heart is greedy and who ever hankers after wealth like a leper.
XBKJ: When this penitent was first invited, he refused our charity; but later he repented and sent his son, who was seated in the congregation.
When he was first called he declined to accept the esteemed alms but repenting afterwards he brought his son and seated him among the assemblage.
Q8JA: The village elders all laughed, saying that the waves of greed have destroyed this penitent.
The village elders all began to laugh, saying that the wave of avarice has destroyed the penitent.
ZPM6: If he sees only a little wealth, he does not bother to go there; but when he sees a lot of wealth, the penitent forsakes his vows.
The penitent draws not near that place where he sees little wealth. Beholding much wealth, the penitent forfeits his faith.
WMFH: O Siblings of Destiny, he is not a penitent - he is only a stork. Sitting together, the Holy Congregation has so decided.
O brother he is not a penitent but a heron. Sitting together the saintly persons have so decided.
ZRCU: The penitent slanders the True Primal Being, and sings the praises of the material world. For this sin, he is cursed by the Lord.
The penitent calumniates the True person and sings the praise of the world. For this sin the Lord has accursed him.
BWUR: Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the Great Primal Being; all his labors have gone in vain.
Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the great persons. All his labours have gone in vain.
6NWN: When he sits outside among the elders, he is called a penitent; But when he sits within the congregation, the penitent commits sin. The Lord has exposed the penitent's secret sin to the elders.
When he sits outside among the elect he is called a penitent. When he sits within the penitent commits sin. God has laid hare and shown his secret sin to the elect.

78SF: The Righteous Judge of Dharma said to the Messenger of Death, "Take this penitent and put him with the worst of the worst murderers."
The Righteous judge said to the death courier, "Take this penitent and place (keep) him, where the greatest of the great murderers are".
WHTW: No one is to look at the face of this penitent again. He has been cursed by the True Guru.
Let no one look at the face of this penitent again. He is accursed of the True Guru.
DT3M: Nanak speaks and reveals what has taken place in the Court of the Lord. He alone understands, who is blessed and adorned by the Lord. ||1||
Nanak tells and preaches, that what has taken place in God's court. He alone whom God had regenerated understands it.
M9PD: The devotees of the Lord worship and adore the Lord, and the glorious greatness of the Lord.
God's saints meditate on God and sing God's praise.
507F: The Lord's devotees continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises; the Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace.
The devotees ever sing God's praise. God's name is the giver of peace.
YVJX: The Lord ever bestows upon His devotees the glorious greatness of His Name, which increases day by day.
God ever bestows on His saint the glory of the Name which increases day by day.
SHF9: The Lord inspires His devotees to sit, steady and stable, in the home of their inner being. He preserves their honor.
God firmly seats His saints in their house and protects His own honour.
47UA: The Lord summons the slanderers to answer for their accounts, and He punishes them severely.
The slanderers the Lord shall call to account and will severely punish them.
Q0DT: As the slanderers think of acting, so are the fruits they obtain.
As the calumniators, mentally act, so is the fruit they obtain.
2W3K: Actions done in secrecy are sure to come to light, even if one does it underground.
The deed done in secrecy assuredly comes to light even though one were to do it underground.
K9M6: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in joy, beholding the glorious greatness of the Lord. ||2||
Servant Nanak has become jubilant on beholding the magnificence of God.
4A9B: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His devotees; what can the sinner do to them?
God Himself is the Protector of His saintly persons. What can a sinner do?
ZJ18: The proud fool acts in pride, and eating his own poison, he dies.
The proud fool practises pride and dies by eating poison.
VJGC: His few days have come to an end, and he is cut down like the crop at harvest.
The few days he had to live are at an end and he shall be cut down like a ripe crop.
4J7C: According to one's actions, so is one spoken of.
As are the actions the man commits so is he spoken of.
WATV: Glorious and great is the Lord and Master of servant Nanak; He is the Master of all. ||30||
Great is the Spouse of servant Nanak. He is the master of all.
CCBL: The self-willed manmukhs forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all; they are caught in greed and egotism.
In greed, avarice and pride the self -willed forget the Primal Lord.
LHN2: They pass their nights and days in conflict and struggle; they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
In wrangling they pass their night and day and deliberate not over the Name.
P1Q0: The Creator has taken away all their understanding and purity; all their speech is evil and corrupt.
The Creator has taken away all their pure understanding and they talk all evil.
V9B1: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within their hearts there is great desire, ignorance and darkness.
With no gift whatever they feel contented. In their heart are inordinate desire, ignorance and darkness.
B93R: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love and attachment to Maya. ||1||
Nanak, it is good to break away from the perverse who bear love and attachment to mammon.
DXHV: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of duality, do not love the Gurmukhs.
They within whom duality abides love not the pious persons.
5L1Y: They come and go, and wander in reincarnation; even in their dreams, they find no peace.
They come and go and wander in transmigration and have no peace even in dream.
6LVD: They practice falsehood and they speak falsehood; attached to falsehood, they become false.
They practise falsehood your utter falsehood and attached with falsehood they become false.
ZEKG: The love of Maya is total pain; in pain they perish, and in pain they cry out.
The love of wealth is all trouble. In trouble man perishes and through trouble he bewails.
3GKQ: O Nanak, there can be no union between the love of worldliness and the love of the Lord, no matter how much everyone may desire it.
Nanak, there is no union between worldliness and love of God however all may desire it.
ZUKA: Those who have the treasure of virtuous deeds find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
They whose treasure contains meritorious acts, obtain peace through Guru's instruction.
EMZM: O Nanak, the Saints and the silent sages think, and the four Vedas proclaim,
Nanak the saints and the silent sages think and the four Vedas tell,
Z4DW: that whatever the Lord's devotees speak comes to pass.
that the words which the devotees utter with there mouth, come to pass.
95H7: He is revealed in His cosmic workshop; all people hear of it.
In His workshop, He appears manifest. All people hear of it.
8TG4: The foolish people, who fight with the Saints, find no peace.
The pig-headed persons, who tussle with the saints, obtain not peace.
43LY: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.
They (the saints)desire virtue for them, but they burn with self-conceit.
0MVB: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained.
What can those wretches do since from the very beginning their fate is evil?

BASF: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God do not belong to anyone.
They who are smitten by the Supreme Lord are no One's property.
1QLW: Those who hate the One who has no hatred, are destroyed by righteous justice.
It is real justice that they who bear enmity with the Uninimical, should perish.
71UZ: Those who are cursed by the Saints wander around lost.
They whom the saints have cursed continue wandering about.
AMVT: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||31||
When the tree is cut at the roots, its branches wither off.
2KRC: Guru Nanak implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; He is All-powerful, to create and destroy.
Within me Guru Nanak has fixed the Name of God who is potent to create and destroy.
X53C: Remember God forever, my friend, and all your suffering will disappear. ||1||
My friend, if you ever remember the Lord all yours troubles would come to an end.
WYGJ: The hungry person does not care about honor, dishonor or harsh words.
The hungry man minds not honour, dishonour and obscene words.
ABSK: Nanak begs for the Name of the Lord; please grant Your Grace, and unite me with Yourself. ||2||
Nanak prays for Your Name, O God show Yours mercy and unite me with Yourself.
4UEJ: According to the deeds which one does, so are the fruits one obtains.
As are the deeds, the man commits, so are the fruits which he gathers.
EDZW: If someone chews on red-hot iron, his throat will be burned.
If one chews the hot steel iron, it causes roasting in the throat.
05V6: The halter is put around his neck and he is led away, because of the evil deeds he has done.
on account of his evil deeds, putting halter around his neck, deaths courier goads him on.
YJ9D: None of his desires are fulfilled; he continually steals the filth of others.
No desire of his is fulfilled. He ever steals other's filth (slander other).
9YWY: The ungrateful wretch does not appreciate what he has been given; he wanders lost in reincarnation.
The ungrateful one feels not indebted for the favour shown and wanders in existence.
FXBC: He loses all support, when the Support of the Lord is taken away from him.
He loses all the props, of one Lord is snatched away from him.
PR5R: He does not let the embers of strife die down, and so the Creator destroys him.
He did not let the ember of strife die, therefor the creator has smitten him.
J30G: Those who indulge in egotism crumble and fall to the ground. ||32||
They, who indulge in ego, crumble and fall to the ground.
CF7C: The Gurmukh is blessed with spiritual wisdom and a discerning intellect.
The Guru-ward is blessed with Divine knowledge and discriminating intellect.
B7B7: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and weaves this garland into his heart.
He sings God's praises and strings their garland in his heart.
2483: He becomes the purest of the pure, a being of supreme understanding.
He becomes purest of the pure and a man of highest wisdom.
BH9C: Whoever he meets, he saves and carries across.
He saves him, who meets Him.
J790: The fragrance of the Lord's Name permeates his being deep within.
Within his heart is contained the perfume of God's Name.
FJU7: He is honored in the Court of the Lord, and his speech is the most sublime.
He attains honour in God's court and has supremely sublime speech.
WFQ4: Those who hear him are delighted.
The person, who hears him, he is exceedingly delighted.
7ZD8: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one obtains the wealth and property of the Naam. ||1||
On meeting the True Guru, Nanak has obtained the wealth and property of God's Name.
F0MD: The sublime state of the True Guru is not known; no one knows what pleases the Perfect True Guru.
The condition of the Perfect True Guru's mind and what does please him no one knows.
9K8F: Deep within the hearts of His GurSikhs, the True Guru is pervading. The Guru is pleased with those who long for His Sikhs.
The true Guru is pervading the hearts of the Guru's Sikhs.
DARV: As the True Guru directs them, they do their work and chant their prayers. The True Lord accepts the service of His GurSikhs.
They perform the service and say the prayers as the True Guru enjoins them. The True Lord accepts the service of the Sikhs of the Guru.
CK7Q: But those who want the GurSikhs to work for them, without the Order of the True Guru - the Guru's Sikhs shall not come near them again.
The Guru's disciple, shall not again draw near him who desires to have some work done by the Sikhs of the Guru, without the True Guru's order.
PEQA: One who works diligently for the Guru, the True Guru - the GurSikhs work for him.
The Sikh of the Guru renders service to the person who heartily works for the great True Guru.
B3SE: One who comes to deceive, who rises up and goes out to deceive - the GurSikhs shall never come near him.
He who comes for deception and who arises and goes for deception; near him the disciple of the Guru draws not ever.
3SDS: Nanak proclaims and announces this wisdom of God. One who is not pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru may do his deeds, but that being will only suffer in terrible pain. ||2||
Lord's discourse Nanak proclaim and preaches. He who without propitiating the True Guru's mind does some deed that person suffers great misery.
3XU1: O True Lord and Master, You are so very great. As great as You are, You are the greatest of the great.
You, O True Lord are very great. As great as You you alone are. You are the greatest of the great.
L9QU: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself. You Yourself bless and forgive us, and tear up our accounts.
He whom You unitest unites with You. You unitest unites with you. You yourself forgivest him and ingorest his account.
UK7W: One whom You unite with Yourself, whole-heartedly serves the True Guru.
Whom you unitest with Your self he whole-heartedly serves the True Guru.
ZGU7: You are the True One, the True Lord and Master; my soul, body, flesh and bones are all Yours.
You are True You are the True Lord. My soul body skin and bones are all Yours.
T8YV: If it pleases You, then save me, True Lord. Nanak places the hopes of his mind in You alone, O greatest of the great! ||33||1|| Sudh||
As it pleases You, so do you save me, O my True Lord O the highest of the high, Yours hope alone, Nanak cherishes within his mind.

AS8C: Gauree Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl: Sung To The Tune Of Vaar Of Raa-I Kamaaldee-Mojadee:
Gauri Ki War. 5th Guru. To be sung on the tune of the Var of Rai Kamal Maujdi.
FRQW: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God By the True Guru's grace He is obtained.
B7HW: Auspicious and approved is the birth of that humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Acceptable is the advent of the man, who remembers the Name of the Lord God.
G8C7: I am a sacrifice to that humble being who vibrates and meditates on God, the Lord of Nirvaanaa.
I am a sacrifice to that person who meditates on the Unattached Lord.
SFQV: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, upon meeting the All-knowing Lord, the Primal Being.
For Him the agony of birth and death is annulled and he meets God the Omniscient Lord.
TQVN: In the Society of the Saints, he crosses over the world-ocean; O servant Nanak, he has the strength and support of the True Lord. ||1||
By associating with the society of saints he crosses the world-ocean, and O slave Nanak he has the true Porp of the one God.
KC89: I rise up in the early morning hours, and the Holy Guest comes into my home.
Rising early let God's saint visit my home like a guest.
BMXK: I wash His feet; He is always pleasing to my mind and body.
I wash his feet and he is ever pleasing to my soul and body.
QKUM: I hear the Naam, and I gather in the Naam; I am lovingly attuned to the Naam.
The Name I hear the name I amass and with the Name I develop love.
K8RT: My home and wealth are totally sanctified as I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
My home and wealth are all sanctified by singing the praises of God.
9C3G: The Trader in the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is found by great good fortune. ||2||
The purchaser of God's Name, O Nanak is found through the greatest food fortune.
25Q6: Whatever pleases You is good; True is the Pleasure of Your Will.
Whatever please You that is good ever-true is yours will.
2U3M: You are the One, pervading in all; You are contained in all.
You alone are working in all and art contained among everything.
4LH8: You are diffused throughout and permeating all places and interspaces; You are known to be deep within the hearts of all beings.
You are diffused through all the places and inter spaces and art known to be within the mortals.
3S1S: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and submitting to His Will, the True Lord is found.
Submitting to his will the True Lord is obtained by joining the society of saints.
KCSE: Nanak takes to the Sanctuary of God; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
Nanak seeks the refuge of the Lord and is ever, ever a sacrifice to Him.
P38N: If you are conscious, then be conscious of the True Lord, Your Lord and Master.
If this thing occurs to you than remember that Lord your Master.
NBDS: O Nanak, come aboard upon the boat of the service of the True Guru, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
Embark on the ship of the service of the True Guru and cross the terrible world-ocean.
C56X: He wears his body, like clothes of wind - what a proud fool he is!
The proud fools wear the clothes of wind.
6BLF: O Nanak, they will not go with him in the end; they shall be burnt to ashes. ||2||
Nanak they go not with the mortal and are burnt to ashes.
BRD7: They alone are delivered from the world, who are preserved and protected by the True Lord.
They alone are delivered in the world whom the True Lord preserves.
0KYZ: I live by beholding the faces of those who taste the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord.
I live by beholding the faces of those who taste God's Nectar.
J3G5: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are burnt away, in the Company of the Holy.
Lust wrath, avarice and worldly love are burnt down in the saints congregation.
93RR: God grants His Grace, and the Lord Himself tests them.
Lord God Himself tests and assays those to whom He extends His mercy.
3MTS: O Nanak, His play is not known; no one can understand it. ||2||
Nanak! Lord's plays are not known. No one can understand them.
0M57: O Nanak, that day is beautiful, when God comes to mind.
Nanak beautiful is the day when the Lord comes into mind.
H38R: Cursed is that day, no matter how pleasant the season, when the Supreme Lord God is forgotten. ||1||
But accursed is the day and season, however pleasant when the supreme Lord is forgotten.
BWT9: O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.
Contract friendship with Him, O Nanak, in whose hands lies every thing.
5X54: They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2||
They are accounted false friends who go not a step with one.
K5A4: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet together and drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.
The nectar is the treasure of God's Name. Meet together and quaff it, O my brethren.
JHC7: Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.
By remembering whom peace is obtained and all the thirst is slaked.
J0C6: So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.
Serve you the Transcendent Lord and the Guru that you mayest hunger no more.
X8S8: All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.
All your desire shall be fulfilled and you shall obtain an immortal status.
SUDG: You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||
As great as You, You alone are O my Supreme Lord. Nanak seeks Yours protection.
RCND: I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.
I have seen all the places. There is no place without the Master.
QN65: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru find the object of life. ||1||
Nanak they who meet the True Guru attain to their object.

69PX: Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.
Brief like the flash of lightening are the worldly ostentations.
1T3K: The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate on the Name of the Master. ||2||
Pleasing thing is only that, O Nanak, by which one meditates on the Name of that Master.
7K4X: People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.
Men have searched all the Simritis and Shastras but none has found Lord's worth.
WLZG: That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.
The person who meets the society of saints he enjoys God's love.
45WY: True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine of precious jewels.
True is the Name of the Omnipotent creator. It is the mine of jewels.
EW4X: That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meditates in remembrance on the Lord.
The mortal on whose forehead such destiny is recorded, meditates on God.
EXQL: O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name. ||4||
O Lord, grant Nanak your guest, the True Name as his viaticum.
ATX2: He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; his hunger never departs.
Within the man is anxiety, but to eyes he appears to be happy and his hunger never departs.
K14N: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1||
Nanak without the True Name no man's sorrow has ever departed.
P5MN: Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.
The caravans who load no Truth to carry with them are beguiled.
N44D: O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, are congratulated. ||2||
Nanak they who meeting the True Guru, recognise the Unique One are congratulated.
E2FJ: Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.
Beautiful is the place where the pious person sit.
VV6Y: They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.
They serve their Omnipotent Lord and their sins are all shed.
415J: The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace of sinners.
The saints and vedas say, that the Supreme Lord is the Saviour of sinners.
SW9B: You are the Lover of Your devotees - this is Your natural way, in each and every age.
The lover of saints is Yours qualitative Name. In every age You has been so doing.
XJ2P: Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5||
Nanak asks for the One Name which is pleasing to his soul and body.
70GT: The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.
with the chirping of the sparrow and breaking of dawn, many currents arise in the man.
YMY7: Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam. ||1||
In the love of God's Name the saints create a wondrous phenomenon.
ABTM: Homes, palaces and pleasures are there, where You, O Lord, come to mind.
The home, mansion and enjoyments are there, where You are heartily remembered.
UQ53: All worldly grandeur, O Nanak, is like false and evil friends. ||2||
The worldly grandeurs are all like evil friends, O Nanak.
SG4Z: The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.
God's wealth is the true capital. Some rare one understands This.
ZF0D: He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, to whom the Architect of Destiny gives it.
He alone receives it, O brethren, to whom the Destiny-scribe gives.
XELH: His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.
God's slave is imbued with the love of God who is looming forth in his mind and body.
1MUW: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.
In the society of saints he sings Lord's praises and so rids himself of all the agonies.
8DE7: O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6||
Nanak, he alone lives, who recognises the One Lord.
294P: The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;
The celandine fruits look beauteous, attached to the parent stalk.
5NMG: but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart into thousands of fragments. ||1||
On severence of love with their Master, they are reduced into thousands of fragments, O Nanak.
HMXE: Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.
They who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die altogether.
WS4P: Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows. ||2||
They who turn away from the Lord suffer agony, like a thief on the gallows.
UR2X: The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.
I have heard the one Lord to be the treasure of imperishable peace.
RACF: He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to be permeating each and every heart.
God is said to be fully filling the ocean, sky and every heart.
MSKU: He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.
He looks equally adorned amongest all the high and low, an ant and an elephant.
6DXK: Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.
The friends, comrades, sons and relatives are all created by Him.
6WXU: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection. ||7||
Whomsoever, O Nanak, God by His pleasure grants His Name, he enjoys His affection.
W8A6: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each breath and morsel of food, whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Lord's Name
Who with every breath and morsel of theirs, forget not God's Name and within whose mind is this spell,
RYMP: - they alone are blessed; O Nanak, they are the perfect Saints. ||1||
they alone are the blessed and they alone are the perfect saints, O Nanak.
V5Q0: Twenty-four hours a day, he wanders around, driven by his hunger for food.
In the anguish of eating, the man wanders about day and night.
15C5: How can he escape from falling into hell, when he does not remember the Prophet? ||2||
How can he escape falling into the hell, when he remembers not his religious teacher?

HB0E: Serve Him, O mortals, who has the Lord's Name in His lap.
Serve that Guru, O mortals, who in his lap, has Lord's Name.
BMHW: You shall dwell in peace and ease in this world; in the world hereafter, it shall go with you.
You shall be comfortable here, and it shall go with you hereafter.
015L: So build your home of true righteousness, with the unshakable pillars of Dharma.
Fix and unshakable pillars of the faith and built the home of true Devotion.
84QH: Take the Support of the Lord, who gives support in the spiritual and material worlds.
Enter you the sanctuary of the Pervading God thus spiritual world and temporal world shall hail you.
WALN: Jachak = beggar. Dan = alms (of the 'boundless Shabad'). Piaria = O Beloved!
(O Prabhu!) I, a beggar, ask for alms (of Your 'boundless Shabad'); give me alms.
The beggar begs for charity: give to me, O my Beloved!
Give me O my Beloved, the beggar begs for alms.
O Beloved! I, a beggar, ask for alms; give me such alms
EADU: Nanak grasps the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he humbly bows in His Court. ||8||
Nanak has grasped the feet of God and he has prostrated himself before His court.
GMKX: You are the giver of gifts, You are able to give gifts; I always remember You.
O Great Giver, O Giving Lord, my consciousness is continually centered on You.
The Giver benefactor, I have ever remembered You.
that I may always remember You alone, who are the Giver who gives.
GNM7: Atul = that cannot be weighed, boundless.
Your treasure is boundless (if You give me alms from it) it does not run out.
The immeasurable warehouses of the Lord can never be emptied out.
The immeasurable store houses of God never get exhausted.
The treasure of Your devotion is so beyond weighing that it does not run short (mool) even a little.
V9UT: Saria = has set right. Sabh kichh = every task. ||1||
O Nanak! The Bani (of the Prabhu's praise) is boundless; this Bani has set right my every task. ||1||
O Nanak, the Word of the Shabad is infinite; it has arranged everything perfectly. ||1||
Nanak, Infinite is the Lord's Name, which has arranged everything.
Sri Guru ji says: O (apar) boundless Vahiguru! Those who have received the Guru's teaching have set everything right; the meaning is, all their tasks have been fulfilled. ||1||
JKYY: O Sikhs, love the Word of the Shabad; in life and death, it is our only support.
Pracitse you the Name, O beloved. Both in life and death it is our support.
76KW: Your face shall be radiant, and you shall find a lasting peace, O Nanak, remembering the One Lord in meditation. ||2||
By remembering the One Lord, O Nanak, our faces become bright and we ever, remain happy.
4L2F: There, the Ambrosial Nectar is distributed; the Lord is the Bringer of peace.
There in the society of saints the peace-bestowing to all, Nectar is distributed.
9X2E: They are not placed upon the path of Death, and they shall not have to die again.
They are no put on the track to death and die not again.
4V8V: One who comes to savor the Lord's Love experiences it.
He who enjoys Lord's Love endures its bliss.
GHNK: The Holy beings chant the Bani of the Word, like nectar flowing from a spring.
The pious persons utter the words like the flowing of the Nectar spring.
XEGT: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those who have implanted the Lord's Name within their minds. ||9||
Nanak lives by seeing the sight of such mortals who have places God's Name is their mind.
PE3Z: Serving the Perfect True Guru, suffering ends.
By serving the perfect True Guru the pain come to an end.
VAWD: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam in adoration, one's affairs come to be resolved. ||1||
Nanak, by meditating on the Name the affairs are set right.
10GD: Remembering Him in meditation, misfortune departs, and one comes to abide in peace and bliss.
By remembering whom the calamities recede and man abides in peace and pleasure.
RG4R: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord - do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||2||
Nanak, ever meditate you on God and even for a moment forget not His Name.
WRAV: How can I estimate the glory of those, who have found the Lord, Har, Har?
How should I recount the Praise of those, who have found their Lord God?
VDA7: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is released from bondage.
He who seeks the shelter of the saints is relieved of his bonds.
WV42: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord does not burn in the womb of reincarnation.
He who sings the praise of the Deathless One is not burnt in womb of existences.
8FFL: One who meets the Guru and the Supreme Lord God, who reads and understands, enters the state of Samaadhi.
He who meets the Guru and the Transcendent Lord, by reading about and understanding God, sits in trance.
E6Y2: Nanak has obtained that Lord Master, who is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||10||
Nanak has obtained that Lord Master who is Unapproachable and Unfathomable.
7VW7: People do not perform their duties, but instead, they wander around aimlessly.
The man performs not his duty and wanders about way-wardly in the world.
4CFZ: O Nanak, if they forget the Name, how can they ever find peace? ||1||
Nanak how shall he attain to peace, by forgetting the Name?
0PE2: The bitter poison of corruption is everywhere; it clings to the substance of the world.
The bitterness of sin is among all and is clinging to the world.
WTHT: O Nanak, the humble being has realized that the Name of the Lord alone is sweet. ||2||
Nanak Lord's slave, has realised that God's Name alone is sweet.
ZERG: This is the distinguishing sign of the Holy Saint, that by meeting with him, one is saved.
This is the sign of the saint that by meeting him one is saved.
9AXX: The Messenger of Death does not come near him; he never has to die again.
Death's myrmidon draws not near him and then he dies not again.
THQP: He crosses over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.
He swims across the poisonous and terrible world -ocean
1ZQ7: So weave the garland of the Lord's Glorious Praises into your mind, and all your filth shall be washed away.
Within your mind weave the Divine garland of God's excellences and all your filth shall be washed off.
N44N: Nanak remains blended with his Beloved, the Supreme Lord God. ||11||
Nanak remains blended with his Beloved the very powerful Transcendent Lord.
REDF: O Nanak, approved is the birth of those, within whose consciousness the Lord abides.
Acceptable is the advent of those within whose mind the Lord abides.
2EUL: Useless talk and babbling is useless, my friend. ||1||
The useless talk my friend is of no avail.
9MH5: I have come to see the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Inaccessible, Wonderful Lord.
I have seen the perfect inaccessible and wonderful Exalted Lord Master.
